root = Stack([explanation, missingClientsSection, sendMessageModal])

explanation = TextContent("I can help you chase clients who are missing *documents*, though I don't have a direct way to manage 'invoices'. You can send reminders individually from the list below. I cannot send a single reminder to all clients at once.", "small")

$showSendMessageModal = false
$selectedClientId = ""
$selectedClientName = ""
$messageBody = "Hi there, just a reminder that we are still awaiting some documents from you. Please log into your client portal to see what's outstanding. Thank you!"

missingClientsData = Query("host_listClients", {filter: "missing_docs"}, [])

sendMessageMutation = Mutation("host_sendClientMessage", {id: $selectedClientId, body: {body: $messageBody, author: "Firm"}})

missingClientsSection = Card([
    CardHeader("Clients Missing Documents", "Select a client to send a reminder."),
    clientsTable
])

clientsTable = @Count(missingClientsData) > 0 ? Table([
    Col("Client", missingClientsData.businessName),
    Col("Contact", missingClientsData.contactName),
    Col("Progress", @Each(missingClientsData, "client", TextContent(client.progress.received + " / " + client.progress.total))),
    Col("Status", missingClientsData.status),
    Col("Action", @Each(missingClientsData, "client", Button("Send Reminder", Action([
        @Set($selectedClientId, client.id),
        @Set($selectedClientName, client.businessName),
        @Set($messageBody, "Hi " + client.businessName + ", just a reminder that we are still awaiting some documents from you. Please log into your client portal to see what's outstanding. Thank you!"),
        @Set($showSendMessageModal, true)
    ]), "secondary", null, "small")))
]) : TextContent("No clients currently missing documents.")

sendMessageModal = Modal("Send Reminder to " + $selectedClientName, $showSendMessageModal, [
    messageField,
    mutationStatusMessage,
    modalActionButtons
], "sm")

messageField = FormControl("Message Body", TextArea("messageBody", null, 5, {required: true, minLength: 10}, $messageBody))

mutationStatusMessage = Stack([
    sendMessageMutation.status == "loading" ? TextContent("Sending message...", "small-heavy") : null,
    sendMessageMutation.status == "success" ? TextContent("Message sent successfully!", "small-heavy") : null,
    sendMessageMutation.status == "error" ? TextContent("Failed to send message: " + sendMessageMutation.error, "small-heavy") : null
])

modalActionButtons = Buttons(
    sendMessageMutation.status == "success" ? [doneButton] :
    sendMessageMutation.status == "error" ? [retryButton, cancelButton] :
    [sendMessageButton, cancelButton]
)

sendMessageButton = Button("Send Message", Action([
    @Run(sendMessageMutation),
    @Run(missingClientsData)
]), "primary", sendMessageMutation.status == "loading" ? "disabled" : null)

cancelButton = Button("Cancel", Action([@Set($showSendMessageModal, false), @Set($selectedClientId, ""), @Set($selectedClientName, ""), @Set($messageBody, "")]), "secondary")

doneButton = Button("Done", Action([@Set($showSendMessageModal, false), @Set($selectedClientId, ""), @Set($selectedClientName, ""), @Set($messageBody, "")]), "primary")

retryButton = Button("Retry", Action([@Run(sendMessageMutation), @Run(missingClientsData)]), "primary")
